legal_units.title: Penalty for furnishing incorrect information in reports or certificates.
legal_units.text: Any accountant or merchant banker or registered valuer, shall be liable to pay a penalty of Rs. 10000 for any incorrect information in any report or certificate furnished under any provision of this Act or the rules made thereunder.
